title: Page 6
content_zh:
景国，京城金陵，原府。

「三哥，娘是不是糊涂了？她怎么能为你挑选一个地位低微的商户女为妻呢？」原四公子原平之大步走进原三公子原治之的书房，气愤难平地囔道。

一身素蓝袍子的原治之正在审视厚厚的卷宗，听到原平之的话，有点讶异地抬起头来，看着脸都气红的四弟，皱眉凝思了一下，方摆了摆手，说道：「坐下说话。多大点事值得你大呼小叫的？」

原平之生得俊美，又爱美，平素最讲究言谈举止，像今天这样失礼地不告而入，大声嚷嚷，确实是罕见的事儿。

原平之看着一身素淡，连个佩饰都没有的三哥，也忍不住皱了皱眉，再想想自家母亲暗中许下的婚事，更是心情郁闷。

原平之坐到三哥的对面，才十五岁多点的少年愁得像个小老头一般，哀声叹气，道：「也是不小心听到母亲院子里的嬷嬷私谈，才知道母亲决意要为你定下亲事了，这本是好事，你都快到弱冠之年了，总不能一直不成亲吧？你入朝为官了，人情礼往，有些的确得需要内宅妇人来做的，可是……唉！真不知道娘怎么想的，为什么千挑万选到最后，偏偏选了最末流的商家女儿！咱们是什么人家？三哥是什么身分？堂堂原府三公子，堂堂景国探花郎啊，如果真的选了一个商女为嫡妻，丢脸都丢死了，到时候还要不要出门见人啊？」

原治之在经过了最初的惊讶之后，很快就恢复了镇定，他静静地听差四弟心无城府地为他抱不平，心思却瞬闻已经千回百转。

他现在己经十九岁多，很快就满二十岁了，也意味着就要到了戴冠之年，正式成年，如果还不成亲，正如四弟所说的，许多人情礼往确实很不方便。

女主人不仅掌管内宅，更重要的是在「夫人社交」这方面，许多事情男人们当面不方便讲，不方便打听，就可以藉助女人们的闲谈当笑话似的先试探对方的态度，然后再做出合适的决定。

原治之也曾想过自己会娶个什么样的妻子，他只希望她温婉贤淑、知书达理，倒没特别在意过出身，因为他以为自己再怎么差，凭借原府三公子的名头也应该娶个土族出身的闺秀，哪怕是没落土族也无妨。

万万没想到，母亲会为他挑选一个出身商户的女子。

母亲是因为他自己对经商特别感兴趣，所以特意为他挑选商户女的吗？

士、农、工、商，良民四大类之中，商家处于最末流，地位很低，如果按照门当户对来说亲，商户女怎堪匹配如今士族第一世家的原府公子？原治之玩味的一笑，心里倒没有什么气愤，更不会真的觉得商人就不如人，只是觉得自己的嫡母也是相当有趣的女子啊，做事往往出人意表。

「三哥？」原平之急了。

原治之笑笑，说：「婚姻大事讲究父母之命，媒妁之言，母亲为我选了这门亲事，一定有她的道理。」

原平之扁扁嘴，想睡什么，话到嘴边又吞了回去。

他苦着一张脸，又重重地叹了一口气。

原治之看着他还有些稚气的脸，失笑道：「我倒好奇，是什么样的姑娘能让母亲看中了呢？」

说到这个，原平之总算恢复了点精神，他眨了眨那双桃花眼，急忙说道：「据说是个美人！」

原治之哈哈大笑，说：「美人好！谁不爱美人呢？」

原平之立即补充道：「说起来，还是咱们的远房表亲呢！是母亲娘家那边一个远房姨母的女儿，姓费，费家出身盐商，后来成为皇商。好吧，皇商好歹比普通商人强点。今年十六岁了，还有什么呢……嗯，据说她很擅长养兰花。」

原治之颔首，沉吟道：「美人，又擅长养兰，有如此雅好，想必性情也很好，有貌又有品，如此佳人，堪为佳妇。」

原平之瞪着他，问：「三哥，你不是说真的吧，？」

「不然你想要三哥娶个什么样的妻子呢？母亲费心为我挑选，必然是不错的。」原治之道。

原平之再次瞪眼，一口气闷在胸中，难受得不得了。

如果母亲是为他原四选择了一个商女为妻，他或许会觉得母亲是单纯认为那姑娘人品好，可以匹配他，可是母亲为三哥选择一个商女为妻，这莫中的意味就复杂多了啊。

难道三哥就不会埋怨母亲吗？

原治之为弟弟对自己的一片心而感动，走过去拍拍他的肩膀，说：「我明白你为我着想的心意，我也不会拿自己的终身大事当儿戏，但我刚才说的话也确实是肺腑之言。如果费小姐真如你所说的这么好，确实堪为佳偶，夫复何求？出身真的很重要吗？本人品性如何更重要吧？」

原平之再次叹气。

三哥说得天花乱坠，他说什么都不信这是三哥的真心话，谁愿意自降身分去匹配一名商家女子？

不行，他要亲自去调查一下那个费小姐，看看她到底有多优秀，能让母亲看中！

第1章(1)

景国，会稽郡，余姚县。

阳春三月，万物返青，嫩芽新蕊，格外惹人。

费氏兰苑里游人如织，士子、学子、达官贵人、富商名绅，每个人都衣着得体，言笑晏晏。

兰苑占地百亩，典型的江南园林，一步一巧，十步一奇，苑中套园，垂花门、随墙门、屏门、月洞门，门门不同，各色雕花窗也形状各异，竟无一重复。

抄手游廊连接各园，可以让不喜日晒雨淋的游人在游廊中便能远观园中种植的各色名花美蕊。

兰苑里除了点缀的常绿植株，主角自然是各个品种的兰花，包括春兰、熏花、建兰、寒兰，以及少量的墨兰。

这些兰花，普通的品种便种植在兰台下，每个移步换景的角落里：好一些的便用瓦盆、南泥盆栽种；再好些的则用紫砂盆，并且替它们单独搭架子，通风遮阳。

如今正是春兰的花期，兰苑中兰花处处开，游人们还未踏人苑中，便己觉幽香袭人，待到仔细去嗅，却又似有若无了，等傍晚离苑回家之后，才会在家人口中得知自己己然染了一身的幽香，久久不散，沁人心脾。

孔子称赞兰香为「王者香」，真乃名副其实。

费氏兰苑，主院西花厅。

靠近窗台的梨花木桌上，一盆素蝶兰正幽幽绽放，盈绿的外瓣，纯白的卷舌，花容秀美，花姿清雅，赏心悦目。

坐在一边绣墩上的几个妙龄少女，则如花一般娇嫩，正边赞赏着花儿，边看向站在桌边讲解的高佻少女。少女身着鹅黄锦缎薄夹袄，月白轻纱半臂，月白锦缎马面裙，裙角绣着一簇春兰，正是这桌上素蝶兰的花式。

「一般兰花的花瓣往往会点缀有异色，比如白色花瓣上面有紫红色晕，春兰中的皇后『绿云』也不例外。凡唇瓣中没有朱点或者整朵花为一色者，被称为『素心兰』。历来兰花以素心为贵，如果素心兰的花瓣又具备了荷瓣、梅瓣、水仙瓣、蝶瓣等瓣形，再加上花香为幽香或清香，就堪称兰中珍品了。」

「明兰，你这盆蝶瓣素心兰是不错，可是我们听说你今年培植出了一盆更希罕的荷瓣素心兰，花儿更是希罕的纯白，怎不让我们看看？」身羞水红纱裙的少女轻声问道。

「是啊，兰花瓣形中以荷瓣为贵，素心里以纯白上佳，花叶又以叶形草为精品，据说你培植出的『素心如雪』集三者为一身，乃不世出的极品，还不快快让我们饱饱限福！」大红锦衣的少女面容娇媚，眉眼间有点颐指气使。
content_en:
Jingguo, the capital of Jinling, the original mansion.

"Third brother, is mother confused? How could she choose a low-status merchant girl as your wife?" Yuan Pingzhi, the former fourth son, strode into the study of Yuan Zhizhi, the former third son, and muttered angrily.

Yuan Zhizhi, who was dressed in a plain blue robe, was examining a thick file. Hearing Yuan Pingzhi's words, he raised his head in surprise and looked at his fourth brother, whose face was red with anger. He frowned and thought for a moment, then waved his hand and said, "Sit down and talk. How big of a thing is worth your yelling about?"

Yuan Pingzhi was handsome and loved beauty. He was always very particular about his words and manners. It was indeed rare for him to come in without warning and make such a loud noise as he did today.

Yuan Pingzhi couldn't help frowning when he looked at his third brother, who was dressed plainly and without even a single accessory. Thinking about the marriage his mother had secretly promised, he felt even more depressed.

Yuan Pingzhi sat opposite his third brother. The fifteen-year-old boy was as worried as a little old man. He sighed sadly and said, "It was only after I accidentally overheard my mother's private conversation in the yard that I realized that my mother was determined to get married to you. This is a good thing. You are almost in your prime, so you can't stay away from getting married, right? You have become an official in the court, and some favors and courtesy are indeed needed.I want a housewife to do it, but... Oh!I really don’t know what I think, why did I choose the lowest-ranking merchant’s daughter in the end!What kind of family are we?What is the status of the third brother?If you really choose a businesswoman as your legitimate wife, you will be embarrassed, so why don’t you go out to meet others?”

After the initial surprise, Yuan Zhizhi quickly regained his composure. He quietly listened to his fourth brother, who was heartlessly complaining for him, but his mind had suddenly changed thousands of times.

He is now more than nineteen years old and will soon turn twenty, which also means that he will reach the age of wearing a crown and officially becoming an adult. If he is not married yet, as the fourth brother said, it is really inconvenient to exchange many favors.

The hostess is not only in charge of the inner house, but more importantly, in the aspect of "lady's social interaction". There are many things that are inconvenient for men to talk about in person or inquire about, so they can use women's chat as a joke to test each other's attitude first, and then make an appropriate decision.

Yuan Zhizhi had also thought about what kind of wife he would marry. He only hoped that she would be gentle, virtuous, and well-educated. He did not particularly care about her origin, because he thought that no matter how bad he was, with his reputation as the third son of Yuanfu, he should marry a lady from the Tu ethnic group, even if she was from the declining Tu ethnic group.

He never expected that his mother would choose a woman from a business background for him.

Did his mother specially choose a business woman for him because he was particularly interested in doing business?

Among the four major categories of good people, namely, scholars, farmers, workers, and merchants, merchants are at the bottom of the stream and have a very low status. If we consider marriage according to the well-matched family, how can a merchant's daughter match the former son of the first noble family?Hara Zhizhi smiled playfully, but he didn't feel angry at all, and he didn't really think that businessmen were inferior to people. He just felt that his aunt was also a very interesting woman, and she often did things unexpectedly.

"Third brother?" Yuan Ping became anxious.

Yuan Zhizhi smiled and said: "Marriage matters depend on the orders of the parents. According to the matchmaker, my mother must have her reasons for choosing this marriage for me."

Yuan Pingzhi flattened his mouth, thinking about sleeping, and swallowed the words as they reached his mouth.

He grimaced and sighed heavily.

Looking at his childish face, Yuan Zhizhi laughed and said, "I'm curious, what kind of girl can attract my mother's attention?"

Speaking of this, Yuan Pingzhi finally regained some energy. He blinked his peach blossom eyes and said hurriedly: "It is said that she is a beauty!"

Hara laughed loudly and said, "Beauty is great! Who doesn't love beauty?"

Yuan Pingzhi immediately added: "Speaking of which, she is our distant cousin! She is the daughter of a distant aunt on my mother's side, surnamed Fei. The Fei family was a salt merchant, and later became an imperial merchant. Well, the imperial merchants are better than ordinary merchants. She is sixteen years old this year, what else... Well, it is said that she is very good at raising orchids."

Haraharu nodded and said thoughtfully: "A beautiful woman who is good at raising orchids. With such elegance, she must have a good temperament. She is both beautiful and classy. Such a beautiful woman deserves to be a good wife."

Yuan Pingzhi stared at him and asked: "Third brother, are you serious?"

"Otherwise, what kind of wife do you want third brother to marry? My mother took the trouble to choose for me, so she must be good." Hara said.

Yuan Pingzhi stared again, and felt a sigh of relief in his chest, feeling extremely uncomfortable.

If his mother chose a business girl as his wife for the fourth brother, he might think that his mother simply believed that the girl had good character and could be a match for him. However, if his mother chose a business girl as his wife for his third brother, the implications were much more complicated.

Wouldn't the third brother complain about his mother?

Yuan Zhizhi was touched by his brother's love for him. He walked over and patted him on the shoulder and said, "I understand your concern for me, and I will not take my life's major events as a trivial matter, but what I just said is indeed from the bottom of my heart. If Miss Fei is as good as you said and is indeed a good match, what else can I ask for? Is family background really important? My character is more important, right?"

Yuan Pingzhi sighed again.

The third brother's words are so exciting that he doesn't believe anything he says. This is the truth of the third brother. Who is willing to lower his status to marry a business woman?

No, he wants to personally investigate Miss Fei to see how good she is and how good she can be for his mother!

Chapter 1(1)

Jingguo, Kuaiji County, Yuyao County.

In the spring of March, everything turns green, with tender buds and new pistils, which is particularly attractive.

There are many tourists in Feishi Lan Garden, including scholars, students, dignitaries, wealthy businessmen and famous gentry. Everyone is well-dressed and talking and laughing.

Lanyuan covers an area of ​​100 acres. It is a typical Jiangnan garden. Every step is clever, and every ten steps is surprising. There is a garden in the garden, with hanging flower gates, wall-mounted gates, screen gates and moon-hole gates. The doors are different, and the various carved windows are also in different shapes, without any repetition.

A hand-held verandah connects each garden, allowing visitors who don't like the sun and rain to view the various famous flowers planted in the garden from a distance.

In addition to the evergreen plants embellished in the orchid garden, the protagonists are naturally various varieties of orchids, including spring orchids, smoked orchids, Jian orchids, cold orchids, and a small amount of black orchids.

The common varieties of these orchids are planted under the orchid terrace, in every corner where the scenery changes as you move around: some of the better ones are planted in earthenware pots or southern mud pots; the better ones are planted in purple sand pots, and separate shelves are built for them to provide ventilation and sunshade.

Today is the flowering season of spring orchids, and orchids are blooming everywhere in the Orchid Garden. Visitors can already feel the fragrance before they step into the garden. When they smell it carefully, it seems to be gone. After leaving the garden and going home in the evening, family members will know that they have been dyed with the fragrance, which lasts for a long time and is refreshing.

Confucius praised orchid fragrance as "the fragrance of kings", and it truly lives up to its name.

Fei's Orchid Garden, the west flower hall in the main courtyard.

On the pear wood table near the window sill, a pot of plain butterfly orchid is blooming quietly, with green outer petals and pure white curled tongue. The flower is beautiful, elegant and pleasing to the eye.

Several young girls sitting on the embroidery pier on one side are as delicate as flowers. They are admiring the flowers and looking at the tall and elegant girl standing at the table to explain.The girl wears a goose yellow brocade thin jacket, half-arms of moon-white gauze, and a moon-white brocade horse-faced skirt. A cluster of spring orchids is embroidered on the skirt corner, which is exactly the pattern of the plain butterfly orchid on the table.

"Generally, the petals of orchids are often decorated with different colors, such as white petals with a purple-red halo, and the queen of spring orchids, 'Green Cloud', is no exception. Those with no vermilion dots in the petals or the whole flower is of the same color are called 'plain orchids.' Orchids have always been valued for their plain heart. If the petals of a plain orchid have petals such as lotus petals, plum petals, narcissus petals, butterfly petals, etc., and the floral fragrance is faint or refreshing, it can be called a treasure among orchids."

"Minglan, your pot of butterfly-petal orchid is good, but we heard that you have cultivated a rarer pot of lotus-petal orchid this year. The flowers are even rarer and pure white. Why don't you let us have a look?" The girl in a red gauze dress asked softly.

"Yes, the lotus petals are the most precious among the orchid petals, the pure white is the best in the orchid, and the leaf-shaped grass is the finest. It is said that the 'plain heart like snow' you cultivated combines the three, and is the best that has ever been produced. Why don't you let us enjoy your blessings quickly!" The girl in bright red brocade has a charming face, and her eyebrows are a bit bossy.
